title: Cohomogeneity-One Ruled Hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{CP}^2$ and $\mathbb{C}H^2$
summary: In this paper, we show how to construct a special class of ruled hypersurfaces in the nonflat complex space forms $\mathbb{CP}^n$ and $\mathbb{C}H^n$. This is done by taking an arbitrary smooth curve in a totally geodesic (complex) one-dimensional submanifold and erecting an orthogonal ruling over each of its points. Concentrating on the $n=2$ case, we also examine the special situation in which the base curve has constant geodesic curvature.
